metadata.question: Does the valley fog coverage in the Upper Arrow Lake area decrease from morning to afternoon on October 22, 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use MODIS daily surface reflectance with cloud QA: Terra (morning, MODIS/061/MOD09GA) and Aqua (afternoon, MODIS/061/MYD09GA) on 2018-10-22, over a polygon covering Upper Arrow Lake valley in BC. Mosaic tiles if needed; if either collection empty, report C1.
2. Masking strategy: Use MODIS state_1km cloud state bits to derive cloud mask (cloudy or mixed) as proxy for fog. Restrict to valley floor using SRTM elevation 400–900 m and slope < 15 degrees to approximate valley fog area. Count valid pixels; if zero, C2.
3. Logic for Valid vs Null: Compute cloud percentage = cloudy_count / valid_count × 100. If percent is null/NaN or outside 0–100, C3. Compare Terra% > Aqua%: Yes => A, else B.
</thinking>

```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); // You must include this line

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var dateStr = '2018-10-22';
    var start = ee.Date(dateStr);
    var end = start.advance(1, 'day');

    // Upper Arrow Lake area (BC, Canada) bounding polygon
    var roi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
      [[-118.8, 51.4], [-117.5, 51.4], [-117.5, 50.2], [-118.8, 50.2], [-118.8, 51.4]]
    ], null, false);

    // Valley floor mask: elevation 400–900 m and slope < 15 deg
    var srtm = ee.Image('USGS/SRTMGL1_003');
    var elev = srtm.select('elevation');
    var slope = ee.Terrain.slope(elev);
    var valley = elev.gte(400).and(elev.lte(900)).and(slope.lte(15)).rename('valley');

    // Helper to compute cloud stats from a MODIS collection (Terra or Aqua)
    async function cloudStats(colId, label) {
      var col = ee.ImageCollection(colId)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(roi);
      var size = await col.size().getInfo();

      if (size === 0) {
        return {label, size, valid: 0, cloud: 0, pct: null, status: 'C1'};
      }

      // Mosaic tiles to cover ROI
      var img = col.mosaic();

      // Use MODIS 1km state QA to derive cloud mask
      var state = img.select('state_1km');
      var cs = state.bitwiseAnd(3); // bits 0-1: 0=clear,1=cloudy,2=mixed,3=not set
      var isCloud = cs.eq(1).or(cs.eq(2)).rename('cloud');

      // Valid valley pixels mask (state_1km mask ensures we only count valid QA pixels)
      var validMask = ee.Image(1).updateMask(valley).updateMask(state.mask()).rename('valid');

      // Count valid pixels and cloudy pixels within ROI at 1 km scale
      var validDict = validMask.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      var cloudDict = isCloud.updateMask(validMask).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: roi,
        scale: 1000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      var valid = (await validDict.get('constant').getInfo()) || 0;
      var cloud = (await cloudDict.get('cloud').getInfo()) || 0;

      if (valid === 0) {
        return {label, size, valid, cloud, pct: null, status: 'C2'};
      }
      var pct = (cloud / valid) * 100.0;
      if (!isFinite(pct) || pct < 0 || pct > 100) {
        return {label, size, valid, cloud, pct: null, status: 'C3'};
      }
      return {label, size, valid, cloud, pct, status: 'OK'};
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    var terra = await cloudStats('MODIS/061/MOD09GA', 'Terra (Morning)');
    var aqua  = await cloudStats('MODIS/061/MYD09GA', 'Aqua (Afternoon)');

    // Handle failures
    if (terra.status === 'C1' || aqua.status === 'C1') {
      console.log('Terra Images: ' + terra.size + '; Aqua Images: ' + aqua.size);
      console.log('Empty Collection for one or both.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (terra.status === 'C2' || aqua.status === 'C2') {
      console.log('Valid Pixels - Terra: ' + terra.valid + '; Aqua: ' + aqua.valid);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking for one or both.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (terra.status === 'C3' || aqua.status === 'C3') {
      console.log('Calculation failure (NaN/invalid) in one or both.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing/Results
    console.log('Method: Valley mask (elev 400–900m & slope<15°); MODIS cloud as fog proxy.');
    console.log('Terra Images: ' + terra.size + ' | Valid: ' + terra.valid + ' | Cloud: ' + terra.cloud + ' | Cloud%: ' + terra.pct.toFixed(1));
    console.log('Aqua  Images: ' + aqua.size + ' | Valid: ' + aqua.valid + ' | Cloud: ' + aqua.cloud + ' | Cloud%: ' + aqua.pct.toFixed(1));

    var delta = terra.pct - aqua.pct;
    console.log('Delta (Morning - Afternoon) Cloud%: ' + delta.toFixed(1));

    // 4. Final Answer
    // A: Yes (decrease) if morning > afternoon; else B: No
    if (!isFinite(delta)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (delta > 0) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }

  } catch (e) {
    console.log('Error: ' + e);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
